quote.author: KeithSmithNBA
quote.text: Given Payton Pritchard had two years left on his deal, I'm a little surprised an extension happened now vs next offseason. The $22M AAV shows how Boston values Pritchard as an important part of their rotation. He should return positive value on that contract without any doubt.

items.title: Jrue Holiday was asked who has been the MVP of Blazers training camp so far.
items.author: Conor Bergin
items.body_excerpt:
Jrue Holiday was asked who has been the MVP of Blazers training camp so far.

His answer:

“Scoot’s been playing really well. He’s doing a lot of everything, knocking down 3s, getting into the paint, putting pressure on the rim and then picking up full court.”
